sources.title: Title 23 Part 300, Appeals — Rule 2.3 through Rule 2.9, Beneficiary Hearing Rights and Requests
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: Part 300 is the Division of Medicaid's general appeals and fair-hearing rule, and Rule 2.3.A.4 names beneficiaries facing a nursing-facility transfer or discharge as one of the categories it covers, which is what makes this the hearing-office source the Rule 2.20 notice's own appeal-rights line points to without naming. Part 300 prints its own table of contents on pages 1-2, so the from anchor takes from_occurrence 2 to land in the body rather than the contents list (the trap CLAUDE.md names for long documents); the to anchor needs no occurrence key because the slice search only runs over the text after that body heading, where the contents-list hit has already passed. The slice runs Rule 2.3 through Rule 2.9 (appeal rights, hearing types, filing routes, the 30-day time limit, and the 90-day decision timeframe), stopping before Rule 2.10, which turns to hearing logistics outside this page's scope.

slice.from: Rule 2.3: Appeal Rights of Applicants and Beneficiaries
